summary:
The invoice-sync idempotency race fix is complete and committed on `fix-billing-idempotency-race`: concurrent duplicates preserve one completed record and original response. Full tests (126 passed, 3 skipped), integration tests (31 passed), Ruff, and unit tests passed. External payment stubs were cleaned up. If `requirements/base.txt` changes, run `make license-check`; do not downgrade `httpx` to 0.23 because Stripe breaks.

Pagination work on `gha/test-workflow` is functionally complete but uncommitted. `InvoiceService.list_invoices()` now has bounded `limit`/`offset`, API validation, and `{items, total, limit, offset}` responses. API tests pass 9/9, pagination tests 3/3, and combined billing tests 18/18. Ruff and whitespace checks pass. Keep commits small.

GitHub Actions migration is partially complete: repository inspection, branch creation, Travis review, and workflow-directory creation are done. Workflow creation/lint/commit/push and Travis disabling remain. Rebase task branches onto `origin/main` and squash before review or when a branch reaches 12 commits.

Invoice PDF queue migration is paused indefinitely.

Invoice-summary optimization is implemented but uncommitted. Aggregated invoice queries were reduced to one per account, and currency conversion now uses one `convert_minor_units_batch` call per currency. All 18 focused tests pass; tenant 73 improved from 38.6s to 4.27s, and `build_summary` from 39.1s to 4.46s. A stable 37-query regression assertion was added. Reports suite: 63 passed, 2 skipped; Ruff passed.

Recent PDF work found two renderer issues. Negative credit lines were omitted; `_format_lines()` now skips only zero amounts, and a regression test confirms credits follow their invoice item. The renderer now uses shared locale-aware `format_money()` instead of local `Decimal` formatting, with exact grouping tests for positive, negative, and zero values. PDF baseline is 12 passed, 1 skipped; focused and formatting tests pass. The latest inspection identified suspect page-break logic: `_page_for_row()` divides row height by 72, potentially miscalculating pagination. Investigate this next, along with the stated JPY two-decimal rounding bug in `ledgerly/money.py`/currency helpers. Paste exact future test output. Staging writes only to Redis `cache-eu-3`; `cache-eu-1` is draining.
